inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: A signature campaign is not proof that Alberta’s government is putting coal ahead of its people. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, is demanding that the government “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration”—a sweeping ban, not a measured plan for protecting watersheds while allowing responsible development. Clean water matters, but so do the livelihoods and families that depend on work and a strong provincial economy. Government should enforce sensible safeguards and weigh the interests of local communities, not let activists turn every resource question into a choice between people and industry.
